method: Visual review of full-clip contact sheets plus original-resolution cropped frames near physical lift and release. Marker coordinates used only to locate crops and identify the onset of motion.
notes: Grip closes before 3.4 s; object begins lifting around 3.8-4.0 s. Fingers begin releasing between 9.7 and 10.0 s; hand clearly withdrawing by 10.3-10.6 s.
